contracts_rationale: No external API surface; the repository port is an internal domain interface captured in data-model.md. C-003 forbids REST/GraphQL changes.
purpose_context: The charter offering service has pack domain models (CharterPack, PackContents, PackDescriptor) and reader/writer adapter scaffolding, but no proven end-to-end parse-to-model-to-write-back path. This mission delivers that narrow round-trip vertical over the local filesystem, with faithful round-trip as the core invariant, leaving pack sources, trust and the distribution surface to the paused design mission.
purpose_tldr: Read a pack's YAML into the charter domain models and write it back faithfully, over the schemas #137 landed.
